data.name: Llewellyn
data.gender_notes: Llewellyn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Celtic name ‘llywelyn’, meaning ‘lion-like ruler’. In Welsh legend, Llewellyn was the name of several legendary princes of Wales. The name is also associated with the god Lugus in Celtic mythology. The name Llewellyn carries the meaning “Lion-like ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Llewellyn usually hope their child will grow to embody lion-like ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, leadership, and courage in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Llewellyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion-like ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Llewellyn total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: לוֵלֵוֵלִין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור קלטי-גאלי. 'לוֵלֵוֵלִין' נוצרה משלושה חלקים: 'לוֵ' (לול), 'לֵ' (לול) ו'לִ' (לו), כך 'לוֵלֵוֵלִין' היא 'לול-לול-לו' (כלת-ברכה). 'לוֵלֵוֵלִין' מקורה במטאפורה של 'לול' (חצי קדיח) ו'לו' (כלת). 'לוֵלֵוֵלִין' מייצגת קשר וכלת-ברכה. 'לוֵלֵוֵלִין' נזכרת בקשרי 'Llewelyn' - סגן-מלך ולדז' האחרון של נוואח, ו'Rhys Llywelyn' - נסיך ולז. קשר 'Llewellyn' ל'Welsh' (קורן-לבן) ו'Rhys' (קשר-ברכה). 'Llewellyn' מסמלת אותן שארכה-קשר-ברכה. 'Llewellyn' מקורה ב'Welsh' ו'Rhys' - קשר-ברכה, 'Llewellyn' - לול-לול-לו (כלת-ברכה).

in_greek.name: Λευελίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Κελτικό-Γαλατικό. 'Λευελίν' σχηματίζεται από τρεις μέρη: 'Λευ-' (Λούλ), 'Λέ-' (Λούλ) και 'Λί-' (Λού), ούτως 'Λευελίν' είναι 'Λούλ-Λούλ-Λού' (Εύνοη). 'Λευελίν' προέρχεται από την μεταφορά του 'Λούλ' (απέναντί) και του 'Λού' (κλήτευση). 'Λευελίν' αντιγράφει τη σύνδεση και την ευνοία. 'Λευελίν' αναφέρεται στα ονόματα 'Λευελίν' (Αντιβασιλιάς και τελευταίος του Βαλντέζ του Νόβ, και 'Ρυσ Λιουελίν' - πρίγκιπας της Βαλές. Η σύνδεση 'Λευελίν' με το 'Γαλέσιο' (Κόρη-Λευκό) και 'Ρυσ' (Σύνδεσμος-Ευνοίας). 'Λευελίν' συμβολίζει την αιώνια σύνδεση-ευνοία. 'Λευελίν' προέρχεται από το 'Γαλέσιο' και 'Ρυσ' - Σύνδεσμος-Ευνοίας, 'Λευελίν' - Λούλ-Λούλ-Λού (Εύνοη).

in_latin.name: Llewellyn
in_latin.long_meaning: Celtic-Gallic. 'Llewellyn' est creatum ex tribus partibus: 'Lew-' (Lul), 'Lew-' (Lul) et 'Lyn-' (Lû), sic 'Llewellyn' est 'Lul-Lul-Lû' (Gratia). 'Llewellyn' provenit a metaphoria 'Lul' ( contra) et 'Lû' (invocatio). 'Llewellyn' repraesentat nexus et gratia. 'Llewellyn' refertur ad connectiones 'Llewelyn' - Vice-Regis et ultimus Valdez de Novo, et 'Rhys Llywelyn' - Princeps de Valles. Nexus 'Llewellyn' ad 'Gallicus' - Cor-Album et 'Rhys' - Nexus-Gratiae. 'Llewellyn' significat aeterna nexus-gratia. 'Llewellyn' provenit a 'Gallicus' et 'Rhys' - Nexus-Gratiae, 'Llewellyn' - Lul-Lul-Lû (Gratia).

in_english.name: Llewellyn
in_english.long_meaning: The name Llewellyn has its roots in the Celtic-Gallic language. It is a combination of three parts: 'Lew-' (Lul), 'Lew-' (Lul) and 'Lyn-' (Lû), thus Llewellyn is 'Lul-Lul-Lû' (Gift-Favour). The name is metaphorical, drawing from 'Lul' (against) and 'Lû' (invocation). Llewellyn represents a bond and gift. Llewellyn is connected to the names 'Llewelyn' - Vice-Regis and last of Valdez de Novo, and 'Rhys Llywelyn' - Princeps de Valles. The connection Llewellyn has to 'Gallicus' - Cor-Album and 'Rhys' - Bond-Favour. Llewellyn signifies an eternal bond-favour. Llewellyn originates from 'Gallicus' and 'Rhys' - Bond-Favour, Llewellyn - Lul-Lul-Lû (Gift-Favour).

data.cultural_impact: The name Llewellyn holds a significant cultural impact on Welsh and Celtic heritage. It represents strength and power, as the name means 'lion-like ruler'. In Welsh history, there have been several princes with this name, including Llewelyn ap Gruffydd, the last native Prince of Wales who led the Welsh resistance against English rule in the late 13th century. The name has also been popularized in modern times through various cultural references, such as in literature, films, and music.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Llewellyn carries the energy of protection, courage, and leadership. It is believed that this name resonates with the innate strength and courage within an individual. Llewellyn is also associated with the Celtic god Lugus, who was a god of the sun, fertility, and the arts. This connection suggests that the name Llewellyn may have deep spiritual roots in the realm of creative expression and transformation. Additionally, as a Welsh name of Celtic origin, it has a strong connection to the ancient Celtic spiritual practices and beliefs.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Llewellyn, meaning "lion-like ruler," embodies the courage and strength of Christ's royal priesthood, inspiring us to boldly serve and protect the faith with unwavering commitment and noble character.

historical_references.reference: According to Welsh legend, Llewellyn ap Iorwerth was the last native Prince of Wales, who ruled from 1197 to 1240. He was known as ‘Llewelyn the Great’ due to his military successes against the English invaders.

Llewellyn ap Gruffydd, also known as Llewellyn the Last, was a Welsh prince who led the last major rebellion against English rule in Wales, from 1272 to 1282. He was captured and executed by Edward I in 1282.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Llewellyn, of Welsh origin, has gained popularity in modern culture due to its association with astrology, wicca, and spirituality. It is often found in the names of astrological websites, blogs, and books, as well as in the titles of wiccan rituals and spells. On Instagram, users with this name frequently post about their spiritual practices, tarot readings, and astrological forecasts. On Pinterest, boards with the name Llewellyn can be found, filled with images of crystals, tarot cards, and other spiritual symbols. On Etsy, there are numerous listings for Llewellyn-themed merchandise, such as journals, candles, and incense. Overall, the name Llewellyn is a symbol of the contemporary interest in alternative spiritual practices and the mystical.
